name: Judge Not
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to avoid hypocritical or superficial judgment, as seen in Jesus' commands to 'judge not, that ye be not judged' (Matthew 7:1) and to judge with righteous discernment rather than by outward appearance (John 7:24). The apostle Paul warns that judging others can lead to self-condemnation since those who judge often share the same faults (Romans 2:1). Instead of condemning, Christians are instructed to receive those weak in faith with grace (Romans 14:1) and to restore those caught in sin with humility and gentleness, mindful of their own weaknesses (Galatians 6:1). Forgiveness is emphasized as the proper response to others' failings, promising that those who forgive will themselves be forgiven (Luke 6:37).
